Original dataset: CS2W: A Chinese Spoken-to-Written Style Conversion Dataset
with Multiple Conversion Types
Authors: Zishan Guo, Linhao Yu, Minghui Xu, Renren Jin, Deyi Xiong
Publication: EMNLP 2023, pages 3962-3979
Paper: https://aclanthology.org/2023.emnlp-main.241/
Source: https://github.com/guozishan/CS2W
Official data-license notice: https://github.com/guozishan/CS2W#data-license
Source revision: be6e0519b433cfa9d8388b23308f1380716254fd

Changes by the MistakeMind project:
- selected a subset of training records and removed exact duplicates;
- excluded other conversion types and inconsistent edit directions;
- adapted fields to the MistakeMind candidate-question schema;
- added provisional Chinese category mappings and source metadata;
- kept original content and reference strings unchanged.

The adapted data remains under CC BY-SA 4.0. Retain attribution, links to
the source and license, and this changes notice when sharing it. The dataset
authors do not endorse MistakeMind or its provisional category mappings.
This license notice applies to CS2W data and the adapted candidate JSON;
it does not replace licenses for unrelated project code or other datasets.
